title: Simplify mdatron over-formalization (8 candidates identified)
description:

Per the over-formalization audit. Eight candidates in mdatron where formalism exceeds substance: (1) cluster-batching shape framework (M1 amendment cost-rubric + applicability rules + decision tree + per-finding annotation could be 2-3 sentences); (2) status tier 3-tier discipline (candidate/accepted/deprecated) with promotion governance for ~30 codes; (3) per-feature axes (9 yes/no axes driving domain activation); (4) 18 methodology event variants with per-variant payload schemas + cardinality classification; (5) error code reserved range partitioning (E0001-E0099 / E0100-E0199 / etc.); (6) per-error-code falsifiability fixture pairs (directory per code with positive+negative); (7) bypass-marker dual-form schema + PR-approval-label + anti-self-application discipline; (8) 4 goals enumeration with 'every artifact must serve all 4 / advance at least 1'. Some of these are simultaneously mdatron AND vsdd-cli concerns since mdatron inherited the form.
